title: Quick Velvety Irish Salmon Poke
description: A satvik-friendly, umami-rich Irish dish featuring sashimi-cut salmon, oregano, and a velvety texture, perfect for a quick and energizing meal.
instructions: Cut the salmon fillet into small, sashimi-cut pieces and place them in a large bowl.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, lemon juice, oregano, sesame oil, honey, garlic, salt, and black pepper to make the marinade.
Pour the marinade over the salmon pieces and toss to coat evenly.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, garnish with microgreens and serve immediately.
Use a fork to gently mix the salmon and marinade again, if needed, to maintain the velvety texture.
Serve the Quick Velvety Irish Salmon Poke chilled, straight from the refrigerator.
Consider serving with a side of steamed vegetables or a fresh salad for a well-rounded meal.
